admission.title: NTA CUET UG 2026 Central University Entrance Test Online Registration
admission.total_posts: All Central Universities (DU, BHU, JNU, JMI, AU)
admission.intro: National Testing Agency (NTA) conducts the Common University Entrance Test (CUET UG) for admission into undergraduate programs across all Central Universities and participating State/Deemed/Private Universities in India.
admission.dates:
• Online Registration : February – March 2026
• Correction Window : April 2026
• Exam Dates : May 2026
• Result Declaration : June / July 2026
admission.fee:
• Up to 3 Subjects : Gen ₹ 1,000/- | OBC/EWS ₹ 900/- | SC/ST/PwBD ₹ 800/-
• Additional subjects charged per paper.
admission.age: • No age limit for appearing in CUET UG. (Candidates must satisfy university-specific criteria).
admission.qualification: • Passed Class 12th / Intermediate examination or appearing in the qualifying examination from any recognized board in India.
admission.vacancies_detail: • BA, B.Sc, B.Com, B.Tech, B.Voc, Integrated Law (BA LLB), and Professional Undergraduate degree courses across 250+ Universities.

admission.title: Delhi University (DU) UG Admissions CSAS Portal Seat Allocation 2026
admission.intro: University of Delhi (DU) Common Seat Allocation System (CSAS UG) for admission to undergraduate courses across all colleges including SRCC, St. Stephen's, Hindu College, Hansraj, and Miranda House.
admission.dates:
• Phase 1 Registration : Open After CUET
• Phase 2 Preference Filling : Following CUET Results
• First Round Seat Allocation : July 2026
admission.fee:
• UR / OBC-NCL / EWS : ₹ 250/-
• SC / ST / PwBD : ₹ 100/-
admission.age: • As per Delhi University admission guidelines.
admission.qualification: • Must have appeared in CUET UG in the relevant domain subjects studied in Class 12th.

admission.title: Banaras Hindu University (BHU) UG & PG Admission CAP Portal 2026
